answer: Cap each payout cluster by "attester diversity": a new agent earns rewards only after vouches from 5 distinct, long-standing operators, and a beacon of shared randomness picks which ones count. Each extra fake needs another real voucher, so attacker cost grows linearly while the meadow of honest peers stays unreachable. A zenith reward cannot be farmed cheaply. Weakness: a patient attacker who bribes five operators still gets through.
